subject: Dedicated capacity: proposed onboarding milestones & multi-year prepay structure (Auriga Systems)
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Natalie Chen <natalie.chen@auriga.ai>, Procurement <procurement@auriga.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proposed onboarding milestones & multi-year prepay structure

Hi Natalie / Auriga procurement team,

Thanks again for the time yesterday — good alignment on traffic shape and the low-latency SLA you need for inference. Attached is a concise onboarding milestone plan and a multi-year prepay structure that maps to the capacity profile you shared. High-level summary: 

- Year 1 (onboarding): 75 reserved A100-equivalent slots (baseline) with a staged increase to 150 over the first 9 months.
- Year 2: additional 100 reserved slots (target sustained throughput increase) — brings total to 250.
- Year 3: optional add-on tranche (50 slots) exercisable at pre-agreed pricing.
- Term discount: 14% list discount for a 3-year prepaid commitment (billed annually).
- Ramp credits: if we miss agreed onboarding milestones, Auriga receives a service credit equal to up to 2 months of capacity fees pro-rated against the missed milestone.

I included a month-by-month milestone table in the attached PDF (Redwood_Dedicated_Onboarding_Milestones_Auriga_v1.pdf) and a draft SOW. Key asks: confirmation of the Year 1 ramp windows and whether Auriga prefers annual or full upfront prepayment for year-one fees (we can improve the effective discount for full upfront).

If this looks directionally right, I’ll coordinate with Ben (pricing) and Lauren (legal) to bake the milestone SLA language into the SOW and return an updated DocuSign package.

Next steps: can we lock in a follow-up on Tuesday 4/20 to finalize billing cadence and the ramp calendar?

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0129

Attachments: Redwood_Dedicated_Onboarding_Milestones_Auriga_v1.pdf, SOW_Auriga_Redwood_v1.docx
From: Natalie Chen <natalie.chen@auriga.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@auriga.ai>
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed onboarding milestones & multi-year prepay structure

Jordan — thanks for the clear draft. A few quick clarifying questions from procurement and infra: 

1) Billing cadence: Auriga prefers annual invoicing, but we need clarification on how credits would be applied against the invoice if a milestone is missed mid-year. Is the credit a refund, or netted against future invoices?
2) SLA triggers: we want the milestone acceptance to be objective (metrics and test harness) rather than calendar dates. Can Redwood accept predefined throughput & p95 latency gates for each milestone sign-off?
3) Discount: 14% is close, but execs asked if you can reach 17% for a full upfront 3-year prepay (we are prepared to do full prepay if the economics are right).

Also cc'ing our procurement manager (procurement@auriga.ai) for tracking. We'll review the SOW and follow up with specific metric proposals by Friday.

Regards,
Natalie Chen
Head of ML Platform, Auriga Systems
N.Chen@auriga.ai
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Proposed onboarding milestones & multi-year prepay structure (internal)

Quick internal note / suggested posture for response:

- Credits: propose we net credits against future invoices rather than cash refunds. That keeps accounting simple and preserves committed spend. Provide a clear formula in the SOW: prorated credit = (missed milestone % * monthly capacity fee) capped at 8 weeks equivalent for any single missed milestone.
- SLA gates: agree to objective gates (throughput and p95) — we should require Auriga to run our qualifying harness (we'll provide a test harness link) and sign off on the results. Include rollback clause if production behavior materially diverges for 30 days after sign-off.
- Pricing wiggle room: if they do full upfront 3-year, we can go to 16.5%. 17% is a stretch but maybe acceptable if they commit to the Year 3 optional tranche up-front (i.e., they buy 3 years at 300 slots instead of 250). If they only prepay 3 years at the baseline 250, max discount = 16.5%.

I'll let Lauren draft the contract language around credits and the test harness. Jordan, recommend you push for full upfront if they can — it's cleaner for both sides.

-Ben
VP Sales, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
From: Natalie Chen <natalie.chen@auriga.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@auriga.ai>
Date: Fri, 16 Apr 2027 09:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed onboarding milestones & multi-year prepay structure

Ben / Jordan — appreciate the quick turnaround. A few follow-ups from our side after initial SOW review: 

- Netting credits against future invoices is acceptable, but procurement will require a maximum credit cap and a clause that if credits exceed 25% of year spend we enter mediation for remediation or termination.
- We will run Redwood's qualifying harness but request a 14-day observation period post-signoff where both sides monitor for production regressions; if regressions occur that meet predefined thresholds, Auriga can roll back to the prior capacity step without penalty.
- On discounting: Auriga is prepared to do full upfront 3-year prepay if you can commit to 17% AND include a one-time implementation waiver (first-month capacity fees waived) and an onboarding concierge (two weeks of co-engineering).

Let us know if the 17% + implementation waiver + concierge is in scope. If it's not, we'll consider 16.5% plus the concierge.

Thanks,
Natalie
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Natalie Chen <natalie.chen@auriga.ai>, Procurement <procurement@auriga.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed onboarding milestones & multi-year prepay structure

Natalie — thanks, and appreciate the constructive asks. We discussed internally and here's a consolidated counterproposal: 

- Pricing: 16.5% term discount on 3-year full upfront prepay for the committed 300-slot profile (includes exercising Year 3 tranche up-front). If Auriga pre-pays for only 250 slots we can offer 16.0%.
- Implementation waiver: Redwood will waive the first-month capacity fees for Year 1 (one-time).
- Concierge: include two weeks of co-engineering support (Redwood Solutions Architect + priority queue during onboarding) at no additional charge.
- Credits & mediation: credits will be netted against future invoices. We agree to a mediation clause once credits exceed 20% of annual spend; we can carve a hard cap at 30% before either party can terminate.
- SLA gates and observation: agree to objective throughput and p95 gates; include a 14-day observation window post-signoff. Rollbacks for production regressions allowed if metrics exceed the agreed thresholds.

I've attached an updated SOW and milestone PDF reflecting the concessions. If this is acceptable, I'll send a DocuSign (link below) for the 3-year full upfront package at 16.5% applied to the 300-slot commitment.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/link/example-sign-AUR-016
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/67890

Would you like us to prepare two parallel DocuSign packages (300 slots @ 16.5% and 250 slots @ 16.0%) so your execs can sign whichever they approve?

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0129

Attachments: Redwood_Dedicated_Onboarding_Milestones_Auriga_v1.pdf (updated), SOW_Auriga_Redwood_v1.docx (updated)
